scorecard.rationale: One placebo-controlled menopause trial of fresh Salvia officinalis tip extract reports lower secondary POMS fatigue (PMID33615001, p=.029, without an arm-by-time fatigue table; separate sleep-exhaustion item unchanged). A dry-extract menopause trial gave an inconclusive exhaustion contrast (IRCT2015111713940N2, p=.634), Spanish-sage essential oil reduced acute healthy task fatigue (different species), Newcastle PD sage trial omitted fatigue, and a single multi-exposure FAERS report cannot attribute fatigue to sage. Extract transfer and multiplicity keep the lean against worsening at minimal_signal. The Jackson crossover favors two mixed drinks for acute task mental fatigue. All active drinks also contain sage extract, ginseng and beetroot, and the control contains none. The study reports blend effects rather than isolated fresh sage or Parkinson fatigue.
